title: Categorical Exemption, pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1, and related CEQA findings; report…
text:
[Council File 26-1414; CD 4]
Categorical Exemption, pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1, and related CEQA findings; report from the South Valley Area Planning Commission; and draft Ordinance relative to a Zone Change from (Q)C4-1VL to (T)C4-1VL; and entails the removal of the (Q) Qualified Classification, which currently applies to a portion of the site situated approximately 170 feet north of the Ventura Boulevard right-of-way and extends to the remainder of the site to allow medical clinic, office or service facility uses, the (Q) Qualified Classification restricts medical clinic, office or service facility uses, the Project proposes a change of use of 11,911 square feet of general office to medical clinic, office or service facility uses; for the property located at 17317 – 17323 West Ventura Boulevard; (5025 North Louise Avenue), subject to Conditions of Approval; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: 17323 Ventura Prop, LLC
Representative: Kevin Kohan
Case No. APCSV-2025-6834-ZV-SPPC
Environmental No. ENV-2025-6835-CE
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - JANUARY 3, 2027 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 15, 2026
